RHOAIENG-60183: LlamaStack Upgrade Path for 1.0.0 (#7403)

* refactor(gen-ai): align BFF with LlamaStack 1.0.0 breaking changes

Update default config to match upstream 1.0.0 distribution: remove
datasetio, scoring, telemetry, and safety from default APIs/providers
(safety is now added conditionally via AddGuardrailsToConfig). Add
file_processors provider (pypdf), rename meta-reference-files to
localfs-files, add ensureAPI helper for idempotent API injection.

Bump test server to 0.7.2.dev20260423, pin rich/setuptools in
requirements.txt, re-record all test fixtures, and update mock
ConfigMap to match the new structure.

* refactor(gen-ai): remove deprecated safety API from test config

Remove safety/shields from the LLS test config to align with LLS 1.0.0
defaults (RHAISTRAT-1362). In production, moderation is now served by
Guardrails Orchestrator / NeMo Guardrails, not LLS. Moderation tests
remain mock-based since they don't depend on LLS for this path.

- Remove safety API, provider, shields, and default config from
  testdata/llamastack/config.yaml
- Remove TEST_LLAMA_STACK_SHIELD_MODEL env var from Makefile and
  GetTestLlamaStackShieldModel() from testutil/constants.go
- Replace dynamic shield model refs with hardcoded "test-shield" in
  moderation tests
- Update moderation test comment explaining mock rationale
- Re-record LLS fixtures to match updated config

* refactor(gen-ai): upgrade BFF to OGX 1.0.0

- Bump TEST_LLAMA_STACK_VERSION to 1.0.0 and switch to ogx PyPI packages
- Rename server-facing env vars (LLAMA_STACK_* -> OGX_*) and HTTP headers
  (x-llamastack-provider-data -> x-ogx-provider-data)
- Replace deprecated `ogx stack run` with `ogx run`
- Standardize vLLM provider configs to use base_url
- Add connectors and external_providers_dir fields to LlamaStackConfig
- Remove deprecated Eval/DatasetIO/Scoring APIs, safety/shields, and
  unused legacy types (ChatChoice, Usage, GuardrailInput)
- Increase MLflow health timeout to 90s for slower environments
- Re-record all integration test fixtures against OGX 1.0.0

* refactor(gen-ai): rename CRD from LlamaStackDistribution to OGXServer

Migrate the BFF from llamastack.io/v1alpha1 LlamaStackDistribution to
ogx.io/v1beta1 OGXServer CRD, aligning with the upstream ogx-k8s-operator
rename and the RHOAI 3.5 migration plan.

Key changes:
- Go module: llama-stack-k8s-operator -> ogx-k8s-operator (ODH fork)
- API group/resource: llamastack.io/llamastackdistributions -> ogx.io/ogxservers
- CR spec restructured: Distribution, OverrideConfig, Workload, Network
- SAR checks, owner references, ConfigMap labels updated to ogx.io
- ClusterRole RBAC updated for ogxservers
- Cypress oc commands updated to oc get ogxservers
- ADR docs updated with new group/resource
- DSC feature flag: OR condition for llamastackoperator/ogxoperator
- Go version bumped to 1.25 in CI workflows and Dockerfiles
- Frontend API contract (/lsd/ URL paths, JSON shapes) preserved

* fix(gen-ai): switch vector_io from Milvus to FAISS and align config with upstream OGX 1.0.0

Milvus Lite doesn't support BM25 sparse vector indexing required by
OGX 1.0.0, causing file embeddings to silently fail. Switch to FAISS
which works correctly with the embedded setup. Also aligns config with
upstream 1.0.0: inline::auto file processor, SQL-backed prompts/connectors
stores, RAG parameters, sentence-transformers trust_remote_code, and
removes deprecated agent_state and HF offline env vars.

* fix(gen-ai): upgrade golangci-lint to v2.12.2 for Go 1.25 support

golangci-lint v2.1.0 was built with Go 1.24 and panics when analyzing
Go 1.25 code required by the ogx-k8s-operator module dependency.

* fix(gen-ai): switch file_processors from inline::auto to inline::pypdf

The midstream odh-ogx-core:rhoai-v3.5-ea1-latest image does not include
markitdown, which inline::auto depends on. Using inline::pypdf instead,
which is available in both midstream and upstream images.

Verified end-to-end on crimson-odh with the official midstream OGX 1.0.0
images (distribution: quay.io/opendatahub/odh-ogx-core:rhoai-v3.5-ea1-latest,
operator: quay.io/opendatahub/odh-ogx-k8s-operator:odh).

* feat(gen-ai): move citation processing from frontend to BFF

Process OGX 1.0.0 citation markers (<|uuid|>) in the BFF's
response handler instead of the frontend. The BFF now strips markers,
resolves filenames from file_search results, and populates
FileCitationAnnotation objects on the response. Frontend simplified
to consume pre-processed annotations.

- Add processResponseCitations to lsd_responses_handler.go
- Request file_search results via Include param when vector stores present
- Simplify LlamaStack config annotations (enable_annotations only)
- Add mock-based citation pipeline tests (TestMockRAGCitationPipeline)
- Update mock client to inject citation markers for testing
- Simplify frontend citation handling with type guard
- Re-record replay fixtures for updated API params

* fix(gen-ai): update Dockerfile Go toolset from 1.24 to 1.25

go.mod requires Go >= 1.25.8 after the OGX operator module upgrade,
but the CI build image was still using ubi9/go-toolset:1.24 (Go 1.24.6).

* fix(gen-ai): correct OGXServer CR command and add DSC condition fallback

Agentic review of the full PR surfaced three issues:

1. Production code used deprecated `ogx stack run` — upstream OGX 1.0.0
   removed `stack` subcommand; corrected to `ogx run`.
2. Mock K8s client used wrong config path (`/etc/ogx/config.yaml`) —
   the operator mounts at `/etc/llama-stack/config.yaml`; aligned with
   production code.
3. Cypress E2E `waitForLlamaStackOperatorReady` only checked for the
   `LlamaStackOperatorReady` DSC condition — added OR fallback for
   `OGXOperatorReady` so tests pass on clusters with the renamed DSC
   field, matching the frontend's dual-key approach.

* fix(gen-ai): correct OGX_OPERATOR DSC component key from 'ogxoperator' to 'ogx'

The opendatahub-operator renamed the DSC component field to 'ogx' in
https://github.com/opendatahub-io/opendatahub-operator/commit/806769ef

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* revert(gen-ai): revert vector_io from FAISS back to Milvus

OGX 1.0.0 added BM25 sparse vector fields to the inline Milvus provider,
which requires milvus-lite >= 2.5.1. Reverting to Milvus now that the
image ships the correct milvus-lite version.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(gen-ai): update vector store tests from faiss to milvus

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(gen-ai): add required db_path to inline::milvus provider config

MilvusVectorIOConfig requires db_path as a mandatory field. Uses
MILVUS_DB_PATH env var with ~/.llama/milvus.db as the default,
matching OGX's own sample_run_config pattern.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
